name: TrackerShield: Hidden Tracker Detection
tag: Walks you through a calm, step-by-step sweep of your car or bags to check for hidden Bluetooth trackers.

scenarios.title: Sweep a vehicle
scenarios.ask: I think someone may be tracking my {vehicle}. Walk me through a sweep. It's been {days} since I last checked.
steps: Scanner
Listened for nearby Bluetooth trackers for 3 minutes. Found {=vehicle + 1} unknown devices, including a parked neighbor's car.
Repeat scan
Walked you around the vehicle with the scan running. One device stayed strong at every spot. The rest faded.
Sweep guide
Gave you {=12 + vehicle * 4} places to check: wheel wells, under the seats, the trunk lining, the bumper and the glove box.
Safety guide
Explained what to do if you find something, before you touch it.
followups: What should I do if I find a tracker?
If you feel unsafe, go somewhere safe first. Photograph it where you found it and contact local police or a victim advocate before removing it, because it may be evidence.
Can the app find every tracker?
No. It finds Bluetooth trackers that are powered on and in range. A wired GPS unit or a switched-off device won't show up, so the physical sweep still matters.
Will the person who placed it know I scanned?
The scan only listens. It doesn't send anything to the tracker.

scenarios.title: Check bags after travel
scenarios.ask: I'm back from a trip with {bags} bags. Check them for trackers I didn't put there.
steps: Scanner
Found {=own + 1} trackers near you. {own} match the ones registered in your account.
Separator
Asked you to move each bag to a different room, one at a time, and rescanned.
Locator
The unknown signal moved with bag 2. Use the sound or signal-strength meter to narrow it down.
Sweep guide
Listed {=bags * 6} spots to check, such as lining seams, wheel housings and outer pockets.
followups: Yes. A tracker left by a travel companion or a borrowed bag is common. The app helps you find it, and you decide what it means.
Do I need an iPhone or Android?
Both work. The guided sweep and signal meter are the same on either.

scenarios.title: Respond to a 'tracker found' alert
scenarios.ask: My phone warned me an unknown tracker is moving with me. I'm {where}. What now?
steps: Safety check
Asked if you feel safe right now and showed emergency options first.
Scanner
Confirmed the signal is still near you, {minutes} after the alert.
Sweep guide
Started a {=10 - where * 2}-step sweep focused on what you carry and the spaces around you.
Record keeper
Saved the time, place and signal readings in a private log you can share with police or an advocate.
followups: Should I go home if I'm being tracked?
If you're worried, consider going to a public, staffed place or a police station instead of home until you've checked. Your safety comes first.
Yes. It stays on your device unless you choose to export or share it.
